Name: Futanari Caroline
Author: RoseyAva
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Simply changes Caroline's sprites into a futanari version of her. This includes her normal, winter, and beach sprites.

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
Extract the zip files and place [CP] Futa Caroline into your mods folder.

[b]Main features[/b]
Changes "Caroline.png", "Caroline_Beach.png", and "Caroline_Winter.png" to altered, futanari version of her. Basically she gets a cock.

[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or higher[/*]
[*]Content Patcher 2.8 or higher[/*]
[/list][b]Shout outs[/b]
I decided to make Caroline a futa because I saw [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/275406265]Eli0630[/url]'s mod on futa Emily and futa Caroline.

Downloads.Description: Using this mod Caroline can fulfill her long held desire to become a futanari.
